title: penstemon cinereus subsp. typicus
intro: Penstemon cinereus subsp. typicus, commonly known as the Arizona beardtongue, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Penstemon cinereus subsp. typicus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
